title.narrative: Stöd till Kosovo Agency of Statistics 2024-2027
Support to Kosovo Agency of Statistics 2024-2027

description.narrative: Insatsen omfattar flera strategiska initiativ för att modernisera kapaciteten för produktion och spridning av statistik från KAS, med fokus på könsrelaterad statistik, harmonisering av prisstatistik, användning av registerbaserade befolkningsdata, standardisering av statistikproduktion som baserar sig på undersökningar och förbättring av ICT infrastrukturen.

The intervention encompasses several strategic initiatives to modernize KAS's statistical production and dissemination capabilities, focusing on gender statistics, price statistics harmonization, the use of register­based population data, standardization of survey­based statistics production, and ICT infrastructure improvement.

The project objective is that Kosovo Agency of Statistics (KAS) has increased the quality and efficiency of its operational processes and provides users with reliable quality statistics. Gender statistics The expected outcome is that KAS has increased the production and dissemination of gender statistics. Price statistics The expected outcome is that the production of price statistics is harmonised. Register-based statistics The expected outcome is that KAS is utilising register-based population data in the statistics production process. Management of the statistics production process The expected outcome is that KAS is implementing standardised processes for survey-based statistics production (GSBPM). Information and Communication Technology (ICT) The expected outcome is that KAS ICT infrastructure and capacities facilitate efficient and secure production and dissemination of statistics.

title.narrative: Support to Kosovo Agency of Statistics 2024-2027
Support to Kosovo Agency of Statistics 2024-2027

description.narrative:
Results achieved in 2024 The first year of the program focused on setting a solid foundation. The Kosovo Agency of Statistics (KAS) strengthened its planning, clarified its goals, and improved its systems for tracking progress. This work has made KAS better equipped to produce reliable statistics and to modernise how it collects and processes data.
Key achievements 1. Economic statistics improved
The Producer Price Index, which tracks how prices change for businesses, was updated to use 2021 as its base year and now uses a revised sample. This makes the data more accurate for government planning and business decisions.
Problems that had prevented the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices from being sent to Eurostat were fixed. Kosovo can once again share its inflation data with European partners.
2. Household Budget Survey redesigned
The survey was updated to meet European Union standards and now includes data on informal economic activity. This will provide better information on household income and spending, which is used by the Ministry of Finance and social protection authorities.
3. Gender statistics strengthened
The programme now has a stronger focus on providing data that supports genderequality policies. Existing products were reviewed, and work began on a new Gender Equality Index that will show where gender gaps exist.
4. Better use of administrative registers
KAS signed an agreement with the Civil Registration Agency to access population register data. This will allow KAS to build a new Statistical Population Register by combining civil registration data with census data. The register will reduce duplication and improve the quality of future statistics.
5. More secure and efficient production processes
Work began on a digital production manual, which will standardise how KAS produces statistics and reduce reliance on individual staff members.
A new Information Security Management System was prioritised to strengthen data security. A plan was agreed to move servers to a secure data centre and improve how data is shared with other institutions.
Impact on different groups In 2024, 60% of KAS staff trained in price statistics and data security were women. This helps to build gender balance in technical roles and strengthen womens participation in key statistical functions.
